text:
Maria Gomez: Quick sync  planning a community workshop + 30m webinar to launch the OSS refapp. Target week: Jun 7-11. Need blog, tutorial, benchmark blurb, and inbound routing.

Alex Turner: Live webinar for Q+A + a short recorded demo to embed. I can demo deploy and run-through.

Samir Patel: Ill own the customer examples and registration copy (search, summarization, chat ops).

Jin Park: Adding a lightweight perf job in CI to emit median/p95/p99 and cost-per-1k-tokens for our sample prompts. Will produce JSON artifact + md table. ETA Wed.

Olivia Chen: Design can do hero + two social thumbs. Need staging URL and screenshots.

Alex Turner: Tutorial flow: install, run locally, deploy, enable caching, view metrics. Tiny code snippet for blog: 
```
from redwood import Client
import os
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
print(client.generate('Summarize this repo in one sentence'))
```

Maria Gomez: Routing: form -> Intercom + calendar invite, tag leads "oss-refapp-june", notify SDRs. Samir confirm fields?

Samir Patel: Required: company, work email, role, est monthly inference volume, primary cloud. Optional: compliance checkbox. Also: Dedicated demo? checkbox.

Jin Park: CI reproducibility note: `make ci-benchmark SAMPLE_PROMPTS=prompts/customer_support.json`. Will call out machine spec and model variant.

Olivia Chen: CTAs: try demo, clone tutorial repo, register. Anchor to benchmark section.

deploy-bot: :rocket: Staging demo deployed https://staging-refapp.redwood.example  creds in 1Password "refapp-staging-demo".

Maria Gomez: Ops timeline: draft blog + tutorial by May 24, design assets by May 28, webinar page live Jun 1, rehearsals Jun 5, webinar Jun 9. Ill post checklist and invite.
